many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# task-dfe2ab35: recolor separator lines

## When to Use
Use for recurring task-dfe2ab35 instances where full uniform background rows/columns function as separators.



In this task, identify any full horizontal rows and full vertical columns consisting entirely of the background color. Recolor every cell in those separator rows/columns to 2, leaving every other cell unchanged. In the confirmed test, background was 5, foreground was 3; the full separator rows were 5 and 14, and full separator columns were 11, 13, 18, and 23 (1-indexed). All separator lines were recolored to 2, producing the correct output.

## Workflow
1. Scan the entire grid for rows whose cells are all the background color and columns whose cells are all the background color.
2. Change the union of those rows and columns to 2 (intersection cells only once).
3. Preserve all remaining cells exactly; preserve grid dimensions.
4. Return exactly one protocol-compliant JSON action.
